title: Chest and Triceps
notes: First official push day wooo! slow, controlled reps.

exercises.name: Flat dumbbell bench press
exercises.instructions: Pick a weight where the last 2 reps are tough but form stays clean
exercises.description:
1. Grab a pair of dumbbells, sit on a flat gym bench, and place both weights on top of your thighs.
2. Bring your shoulders back, engage your abs, take a breath, and flex your arms.
3. Kick both dumbbells up with your thighs as you lie back.
4. With your arms straight and dumbbells over your chest, dig your shoulder blades into the bench and place your feet flat on the floor.
5. Take another breath and lower both dumbbells to your sides. Keep your elbows somewhat tucked.
6. Lower the weights until your elbows are at torso level.
7. Press both dumbbells to the starting position, bringing them together as you exhale.

exercises.name: Dumbbell skull crushers
exercises.instructions: Go light, form matters more than weight here. Keep elbows pointing straight up.
exercises.description:
1. Grab a pair of dumbbells and lie on a flat gym bench.
2. Straighten your arms and position the dumbbells over your chest with your wrists neutral (hands facing one another).
3. Bring your shoulders back, engage your abs, and plant your feet flat on the floor.
4. Take a breath and slowly bend your elbows to bring the dumbbells to the sides of your head.
5. Hold the position momentarily and extend your arms by squeezing your triceps. Exhale near the top.

exercises.name: Tricep kickback
exercises.instructions: Light weight, full extension at the top. squeeze and hold 1 second each rep
exercises.description:
1. Grab a light dumbbell and hold it to your side with your palm facing your thigh.
2. Lean your torso forward as you push your butt back to maintain a neutral back.
3. Lift your elbow to your side, inhale, and extend your arm by engaging your tricep. Breathe out.
4. Hold the contraction for a second and slowly bring the dumbbell back down as you breathe in.
5. Keep your shoulder and elbow in a stationary position throughout each repetition.

exercises.name: Machine chest press
exercises.instructions: Keep your back flat against the pad and drive through your chest, not your shoulders
exercises.description:
1. Select the appropriate load and adjust the seat height so the handles are at chest level.
2. Sit down, bring your shoulders back, and grab the handles with a neutral grip.
3. Plant your feet flat on the floor and engage your core.
4. Take a breath and press the handles forward until your arms are almost fully extended. Breathe out.
5. Slowly bring the handles back to the start, feeling your chest stretch. Breathe in.
6. Don't let the weight stack rest between reps — keep tension on the chest throughout.

exercises.name: Triceps rope pushdown
exercises.instructions: You know this one! but keep back straight and chest high, if form is failing then go down in weight. but also what doesnt kill you
exercises.description:
1. Pick the appropriate weight, set the pulley to the highest position, and attach a rope.
2. Grab the rope with both hands and bring your elbows to your sides.
3. Take a step back and lean your torso forward slightly.
4. Take a breath and extend your arms while keeping your elbows in position. Breathe out.
5. Bend your arms slowly and breathe in. Stop when your wrists end up slightly higher than your elbows.
